about_p1: Our work covers roadside assistance, accident recovery, long distance towing, and car and light truck transport for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: We work out of Fayetteville and the towns around it.
area_h2: We work in and around Fayetteville

services.title: Roadside assistance
services.body: A jump, a tire swap, a lockout or a can of fuel gets handled at the shoulder when that is all the car actually needs.

evidence.text: I will ALWAYS use Bestco Towing for our roadside assistance.
evidence.also: Before I could hang up with my roadside, they were contacting me to provided me with updates from the moment roadside re

services.title: Accident recovery
services.body: After a wreck the car is cleared from the scene, loaded without doing more damage, and taken where you or your insurer want it.

evidence.text: Not too long ago I was in a very bad accident and a family member told me about getting bestco to tow away my car.
evidence.also: I was in an accident last week with my Nissan Ultima and I set up an appointment yesterday through Verizon roadside assi

services.title: Long distance towing
services.body: Longer hauls ride flat on the deck the whole way, chained at the factory points, so a long trip does not cost you a second repair.

evidence.text: Bestco Towing arrived 1 hours after the call to be towed when the location was an hour away.

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.

evidence.text: Called them got the quote and my car towed within 1 hour.
evidence.also: They arrived in 15 to 20 minutes to tow my son's car.

reviews.author: Miranda Reed
reviews.text: Called them got the quote and my car towed within 1 hour. They communicated efficiently and got the job done. I will forever do business with Bestco. Also I get my inspections with them they are very quick with this as well. Thank you for all you do !

reviews.author: Angie Smith
reviews.text: This is a good,honest company,that is willing to work with their customers.These people stayed in contact with us and arrived earlier than expected. When the guy got here,he was fast, professional and proficient. Their price was very good as well,thanks for your help Bestco.

reviews.author: Linda Jenkins
reviews.text: Friendly, quick and safe service. They arrived in 15 to 20 minutes to tow my son's car. It didn't take long to get the car hitched and to my house. They let my son ride back with them. All I can say is they GREAT SERVICE!! If you need towing, give them a chance!!

reviews.author: Lisa Hutchison
reviews.text: The driver was excellent at his job making sure the surrounding vehicles in the parking lot were safe while he safely moved mine onto his truck. He got all needed details for delivery as well as being friendly while attending to his job. I will highly recommend this company to anyone and will put them into my phone contacts for other emergencies.

reviews.author: Emmanuel Battle
reviews.text: This company is just phenomenal!! My first and final call just pleasant. The communication was A1. I was aware of every single thing during the process of coming to retrieve my vehicle to it's destination. I was also informed 10 minutes before arrival so I can be prepared to be outside to help if needed. This service was quick, fast, efficient in every possible way. I'm so grateful that I introduced myself to this individual that did an awesome job and taking care of my vehicle from pick up to drop off. Thanks again!!

reviews.author: Laurel Berry
reviews.text: Wonderful company! Terrell went above and beyond to help me feel at ease during a very stressful situation, every detail was handled with care and with fast service in extreme heat! I was impressed by Terrell's professionalism and ability to clearly explain my situation.

reviews.author: Sondra Neihart
reviews.text: They were there within 30 minutes, and I didn't have to worry about anything! They took care of everything and were reasonably priced! I'd definitely use this service again!

reviews.author: Beatriz Mendoza Paddyfoote
reviews.text: Our family was heading to South Florida when our rental car suffered a flat tire. Enterprise set up the towing service. Mr Bobby Dale Raynor called within minutes of the towing service being set up. He arrived within 10 minutes and was very friendly and courteous. Ensure we took all our belongings in the cold morning while we waited for our uber. He was kind and we will use him in the future when in Fayetteville. Thanks Mr Bobby!

reviews.author: christi hunt
reviews.text: I had a great experience with this company. Called a few hours before needing a tow, they gave me a quote, which was lower than what some other companies gave me, and they met me right on time for the time I asked for. The tow truck driver was nice and professional. Everything was hassle-free. Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Karima Hood
reviews.text: The driver, Terrell was very nice, friendly.. He made sure to call and let me know when my suv was at its location and whom he gave my keys too. Thank you!

reviews.author: Abraham Smiley
reviews.text: Customer service from this company and Driver is unmatched, Very Professional and Knowledgeable. Appreciate the service and I recommend everyone to use this company for Tow. Thank you so very much in my time and need of assistance.

reviews.author: P Jill
reviews.text: Staff was amazing they came and towed my car for a very reasonable price they will definitely continue to get my business i recommend them to everyone if you want quality, efficient and fast services!

reviews.author: allan gentry
reviews.text: This company provided very prompt service and was reasonably priced. The entire process was very easy. I recommend them for all your towing needs!

reviews.author: Foxx
reviews.text: Terrel is really good at what he does. A very honest man.He definitely went over and beyond to help me. He even went out the way just so I can get my car towed. I’m choosing this company every time.

reviews.author: Kallen Nelson
reviews.text: Bestco was able to come quickly to pick up our broken down car and take it to the dealership for us. Very nice and helpful! Will definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Khalil
reviews.text: They were fast and effective and the whole process was quick and painless. It's clear the guy knew his trade well. Prices were reasonable. Would definitely recommend and use again.

reviews.author: Brian B Free
reviews.text: I called Bestco after experiencing some cooling issues with my car. I spoke with Terrell over the phone and he arranged quick, efficient towing to the shop of my choice. I just gave him the addresses for pick up/delivery and they handled it from there. The affordable price put the icing on the cake. Thanks again Bestco!

reviews.author: Jessica Brown
reviews.text: Communication was prompt and friendly. Had to have a car towed from out of town and they were quick to respond with extremely fair pricing! No complaints, car was delivered as promised!

reviews.author: garion Johnson
reviews.text: This guy is awesome. Very professional, picked up my car right away payment was easy!!! Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Tabatha Quinones
reviews.text: Bestco was quick, efficient, and very professional. They were down a truck and still managed to come pick up and drop off my vehicle within an hour. Thanks BESTCO!

reviews.author: Jarred Johnson
reviews.text: Fast and detailed service with effective communication and very professional and top tier in the service they provide. Pricing is cost friendly

reviews.author: Rosealene Stocks
reviews.text: Could not have asked for a better towing company BESTCO! I explained my situation to Terell (AKA TAT) and he sent Mr. Mike to my home as promised. The gentleman was very professional, polite and knowledgeable about what he was doing. He called me back as promised after he drop my car at its destination. I would recommend BESTCO for your towing needs! Thanks TAT AND Mr. Mike!!!

reviews.author: Tanya McLean
reviews.text: Great customer service! Driver had excellent communication with me in regards to his arrival for pickup, his arrival at repair shop, and even the name of the person the keys were left with. He even sent me a video showing me an issue with my tire that was unrelated and that I was unaware of. Super helpful!

reviews.author: Lani Mason
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing service. They communicated SO well. When our truck was dropped off they sent a picture of it in the parking lot and then called to let us know who at the shop had the keys. The gentleman that came out to pick the truck up was super sweet and made it very easy. 10/10 would recommend 100 times over!

reviews.author: Ashli
reviews.text: Terrell was very kind and timely. There was great communication and even made sure I knew who he gave my keys to once at the shop. Unfortunately dealt with plenty of tow companies in my day but he was by far the best and most helpful. Thanks again Terrell.

reviews.author: Michael Payne
reviews.text: The driver, Terrell, who picked up my 92’ vette was very professional and answered all of my questions concerning what was going to be done with getting my car to the repair shop! He walked around my car with me and he actually identified a crack at the driver’s door exterior that I hadn’t noticed. If I have any towing needs I will definitely be using BESTCO Towing! Thanks!

reviews.author: Tabbie Berry
reviews.text: Gentleman was very nice, friendly.. He made sure to call and let me know when my vehicle was at its location and whom he gave my keys too.. great job

reviews.author: sylvia crumpler
reviews.text: Mr. Walked was professional from the moment he picked up the phone. Got all my info and literally took only a few minutes to give me a price. Was otw when I gave the ok..got my car to the location and sent a Pic and called me with all the details..prices are very reasonable . Call Bestco if you want a good towing experience

reviews.author: Amelia Taylor
reviews.text: Bestco Towing is quick and amazing! My children and I broke down in the middle of school traffic. The time when busses and everyone is picking up children. I called and they showed up within 20 minutes. I will ALWAYS use Bestco Towing for our roadside assistance. Thank you! You saved our day.

reviews.author: Shawn Simpson
reviews.text: I called the day before and got the estimate. The Terrell is who I talked to was not rude in anyway and made me feel less anxious while talking with me. I have never had to get a vehicle towed before and for a first time experience, I will forever use them for towing service I made need in the future. This man knows customer service and on arrival to get my car literally less than what he told me to get there and showed up promptly and ready to go. They are a great business and I’ll recommend them 10/10 to anyone who needs towing!

reviews.author: Mark Dow
reviews.text: Needed a vehicle towed to Southern Pines. Bestco was able to get it done same day, process was easy, staff was extremely helpful and friendly. Prices were very affordable as well. Would recommend for anyone looking for tow services.

reviews.author: Shannon Crockett Key
reviews.text: I couldn’t have asked for a better Tow Truck company to do business with than Bestco Towing Services. Mr. Brasker Walker was the towing driver that picked up my car to take to the auto shop for repair. From the time I received Mr. Walker’s call, till Mr. Walker arrived at my home, was 15-minutes tops! I found Mr. Walker very sincere, he got my car on the tow truck within 20-minutes and told me he would call me once he got the car to the auto shop and give me the name of the person who he turned my car keys over to, which is exactly what Mr. Walker did. It was a pleasure doing business with Mr. Walker during that short visit.

reviews.author: Christy Swinson
reviews.text: BESTCO is absolutely outstanding and exhibits top notch customer service. I was very overwhelmed when my vehicle broke down in Clinton, NC. The owner, Mr. Terrell Walker, quickly responded to the call late in the evening and was very reassuring about the disabled vehicle’s issue. His kindness and professionalism are greatly appreciated. The prices are very reasonable as well! Thank you BESTCO for living up to your name! You are the BEST!

reviews.author: Christine Pratt
reviews.text: WOW! Great service: they let me know how far they were out, made me feel safe, gave me a ride to the shop, and the whole process was quick! This kind of service needs to be recognized…Thank you!

reviews.author: David Riska
reviews.text: I called Bestco because I needed my car to be towed to a service center. They were very prompt, friendly, professional and reasonably priced. I would have paid a higher price for the quality of the service that I received. I highly recommend this towing service.

reviews.author: Necole Nunya
reviews.text: Great towing service! My son was needing his car towed to a repair shop. He was at work so I was calling around for him getting rates. I had called three other services prior to this one & they were all pretty much giving me the same rate. One had even told me that it was pretty much the going rate here in Fayetteville, but God said try another caller. I called Bestco Towing & sure enough they had the BEST rate! I spoke with Terrell, his communication was on point. He was very polite & professional! Would recommend to anyone in need of a towing service! Stay Blessed!

reviews.author: Dennis McNair
reviews.text: I call and made appointment with BESTCO Towing Service. They picked up my Truck and delivered it to Reed Lallier Chevolet Dealer for repair. BESTCO driver called me back and gave me name Chevolet Staff person that received the keys. He also emailed me the location the truck was in the parking lot of the dealership.

reviews.author: LaToya Wells
reviews.text: "I can't recommend Mr. Terrell and Bestco Towing Service highly enough! Every time I've needed assistance with my vehicle, he has been prompt, professional, and incredibly helpful. Not only does he provide excellent service, but his prices are also very reasonable. If you're looking for reliable towing, don't hesitate to reach out!!

reviews.author: Arianna Godwin
reviews.text: Best Tow company I’d definitely recommend them to anyone took less than an hour for them to arrive his customer service was great as well 10/10 !!!

reviews.author: Marla Finn
reviews.text: Tyrell was professional and an absolutely joy to talk to. Thank you for taking good care of us. I will always have your number in my phone from now on! Great service.

reviews.author: Danielle Leeks
reviews.text: Quick and easy, they towed my car even though I could not leave work. Would definitely call again!... Editing because this is my 2nd time using them and they were just as quick and easy as the 1st time. Thanks a bunch!

reviews.author: Valerie Hair
reviews.text: A deer in ran into my car on the way to work. Causing my Cadillac xt6 to be disabled. I called Bestco Towing immediately they responded. Professional and friendly service.

reviews.author: Marissa Pierce
reviews.text: Simply the best...service was amazing, Bobby the tow driver was nice and professional. Received 3 different quotes from 3 different tow companies and BestCo was the most reasonable in price for the distance I had to be towed. Will definitely use them again if I ever need another tow. They say first impressions make a lasting one and they made a lasting one to me. 100% top notch service...amazing company.

reviews.author: Marin Bandel
reviews.text: I had an emergency while on the road today and Bestco came out within 40 minutes. The driver was so kind and professional. Would highly recommend their services!

reviews.author: Monique Kendall
reviews.text: I had a 5 star experience with Bestco Towing. They were prompt, professional and courteous. I stored their number in case I ever need another tow. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rosie L
reviews.text: Very good communication from start to finish. Was quoted a price at the beginning and that price never changed. Tow truck driver sent me a picture of my vehicle and let me know when it was picked up and loaded on the truck, also sent another picture when my car was delivered to its destination to let me know that it had safely arrived. Would definitely recommend this tow truck company. In addition, was more reasonable than the tow truck company AAA had recommended.

reviews.author: Shawn Johnson
reviews.text: Great service! Professional and quick! Terrell always takes care of us real good! Check out all of the services they provide, you won't be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Inita mclucas
reviews.text: Thank You Terrell for always coming when we need You!!! I pray that God will continue to Bless You your family and your business. We Appreciate your curiosity and helpfulness. Continue to show curiosity and respect and your business will always be blessed.

reviews.author: Samantha Hamilton
reviews.text: Terrell was prompt, kind, and professional. No hassle with great service. Needing a vehicle towed is usually not something people look forward to, but at least if it has to happen there are people like Terrell out there who make sure you are taken care of. If the rest of the employees at BESTCO provide the same quality of service it will be hard to beat.

reviews.author: Edsel Porter
reviews.text: Most Professional and careful in handling the car! The car shifter would not shift into gear but the serviceman had an idea that was of experience that worked to get the vehicle on and off the truck! Outstanding performance and service!

reviews.author: Makia Pike
reviews.text: Amazing customer service! My driver’s name was Ben. He helped calmed my anxiety and talked me through the process. He was super nice and took good care of my car. My car arrived safely and secure. He called me before he arriving and then made sure to get a background on the car. He even arrived early in rush hour. If I ever have to have my car towed again, I will definitely be calling this company again. Thank you so much for all your help!

reviews.author: danille
reviews.text: They were very professional and prompt. I love the fact they text and take a picture of your location of drop off! 10/10. Best customer service of towing I’ve had. Definitely recommended.

reviews.author: Qushonda Cotton
reviews.text: Awesome company, I called short notice and received great fast same day customer service. He was very nice and we had great conversations all while he was providing his services. I would most definitely use again if needed and refer them to friends and family.

reviews.author: Lauraley B
reviews.text: Amazing service! The driver though under a ton of stress and constant phone calls was completely courteous, pleasant and professional. I was very impressed! And I will definitely use them again if necessary. I have USAA and they have a winner in choosing Bestco to tow me!!!

reviews.author: Tina Pettit
reviews.text: Fast, friendly, and professional. What can I say? Saved my behind and worked fast and at beyond a fair price! Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Diane Diaz
reviews.text: I can’t believe it’s been 3 months since I received service from this amazing company. Staff is friendly and efficient. Everyone from the customer service rep, the tow truck driver and the mechanic were all top notch. Highly recommend them! Single female, traveling cross multiple states with a flat in a foreign town could have certainly looked very differently. They had me back on the road in no time. I was so blessed by them and you will be too.

reviews.author: Ambria Willoughby
reviews.text: From the beginning to the end, this was best experience I have ever had with road side assistance. Before I could hang up with my roadside, they were contacting me to provided me with updates from the moment roadside reach them. The staff were professional and very friendly. The tow truck driver as well as the contact person, we concern about my safety as well as the needs for my vehicle. I can honestly say this the best and the first roadside experience that went beyond and above the call of duty. They are highly recommended.

reviews.author: Personal Account
reviews.text: Man was very polite and informative, he asked all the information he needed and gave me a price. I was able to get a tow within minutes of the call (lucky me). Hands down the only company i will be working with from now on. Service was great.

reviews.author: Lisa Johnson
reviews.text: My insurance contacted the company and before I got off the phone with them they were calling me to verify my information and tell them they were on the way. They were there in no time and the driver Terrell (I think that's what his name was) was so nice and very professional and treated my old car like it was a new one. Their fast service and quality of service and a great attitude made me feel at ease. Thank you guys for being there for me today. Ms Johnson

reviews.author: Yulonda Williams
reviews.text: Bestco Towing what can I say except thank you thank you thank you. I was in need of a tow & I called Bestco Towing they were on it they didn't waste anytime getting to me. The tow truck driver Terrell was such a professional & had awesome mannerisms. If you would ask me who would I prefer for a tow I would say Bestco. Thank you again Terrell may God continue to Bless you & your company.yw

reviews.author: MJ Gonzalez
reviews.text: Bestco was quick, efficient and went the extra mile. Their rates were the best and I called like three other people. Very friendly and fast service. Would recommend to all in need.

reviews.author: Franklyn
reviews.text: Excellent customer service! Terrell and his team are one of the nicest people around! So very helpful with all your needs

reviews.author: Patrick Williams
reviews.text: Thank you BESTCO. We use your service for our fleet of vehicles when needing inspections, towing, etc. each time we have been greeted with professional team members. We have experienced awesome support and thank you for great service.

reviews.author: Sandra Thompson
reviews.text: They responded very quickly & I was pleased with their service. The gentleman, Terrell who came to pick up my vehicle was very nice & pleasant to deal with. I wouldn't hesitate to call them again. Sandra Thompson

reviews.author: Journey Storm
reviews.text: Our "go-to" Johnny's Towing was unavailable and recommended "Bestco". A pleasure to do business with them! Got to the vehicle immediately & a few minutes before we did. Was very patient and kind with me and took good care in getting vehicle on truck with a fully blown tire as well as putting it down in our yard. Awesome friendly folks and we needed that with all we'd been going through. Thank You so much!!

reviews.author: Meghan Murphy
reviews.text: I received their services through Precision Auto and I was thoroughly and highly satisfied with how fast and precise they were with locating the car on the side of the road. A no worry service! My fiance gave them a call from work and I met them to give the key and it was easy peasy!

reviews.author: hamzah alayyan
reviews.text: I had a great experience dealing with this company, from start to finish the service was excellent. I would recommend everyone to use Bestco towing. Timing is important to me and the gentleman had my car delivered to where I needed it to be in a matter of 30 minutes. Even after a long day of work they’ll still try their best to help you with your needs.

reviews.author: Cheyenne Lewis
reviews.text: This company is very professional and the employees are nice! Communication is good and they work fast and efficiently. Had my car towed and from start to finish it MAYBE took them an hour. Price was very fair. Will definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Deborah Galloway
reviews.text: I appreciate the professionalism and the kind courtesy of the young man that helped me today. My vehicle was towed to a mechanic shop within the hour I called and repaired before 5pm today. I am very pleased with Bestco Towing and I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Keefe Enterprises
reviews.text: Quick response time to my towing needs. Very professional and courteous service. Clean tow vehicle and well dressed uniformed driver. Kept me informed when my vehicle reached destination. Have used in the past and can always rely on Bestco Towing.

reviews.author: Lisa Melvin
reviews.text: They are the best at professionalism, promptness and efficiency. Terrell that you for taking the call and sending Bobby so quickly to get my vehicle. You both were a lifesaver that day. Bobby, thank you for responding to my nervousness about my vehicle and assisting with me with taking pictures prior to taking it to the shop. I couldn't have requested a better person to assist during my crisis. Your patience and understanding helped me deal with the situation much better. I would recommend Bestco Towing services...No attitudes, just good people with good conversation. Thank you again Terrell and Bobby!!!!

reviews.author: Karen Knox
reviews.text: Bestco is a Great Experienced, Knowledgeable and Professional Business, from the first phone call to confirm the information for service is Correct to the last phone call to let you know your vehicle had been delivered. Once confirmed they tell you they are either on the way or give you a time when they will arrive. We can truly say they are true to their word keeping you informed through texts until their arrival, they are quick and they are busy. We have recommended family and friends they too have said how please they are, try BESTCO TOWING SERVICE you will Definitely be Pleased.

reviews.author: Ms. T.
reviews.text: This company accepted a request for a tow 15 minutes before closing time and saved my day after another towing company "forgot" about my vehicle. The driver showed up in his flat bed within minutes and rode off into the sunset, van on board. He called my daughter when it was safely delivered...great company...they definitely have not seen the last of me!

reviews.author: Jamika Barnwell
reviews.text: We didn’t encounter face to face however making sure everything was in order was excellent. Great communication!! Highly recommend

reviews.author: John Matthews
reviews.text: Bestco took care of me and towed me home. They were quick and responsive and I felt fairly priced. Would definitely use them again. Although I hope I don't need their services again soon.

reviews.author: tashima wilson
reviews.text: Received service today, quick response, professional, and honest/transparent communication! Definitely will utilize their service if needed.

reviews.author: Teffery Mckoy
reviews.text: Awesome Service! Got my address and came right on, hooked up, and got my vehicle to the destination, called and sent a photo to let me know everything was good too go!

reviews.author: Sheba Smiles
reviews.text: Bestco, was awesome! I received a call that they were enroute to me. The driver was helpful and knowledgeable. He gave an arrival time of 15 minutes but arrived earlier. He was careful and made sure my vehicle was exactly where I wanted it. An awesome service!

reviews.author: Betty Thomas
reviews.text: They was so polite. And picked up my car in a very timely matter.They also had a clear communication with me. Professional and dependable. I would recommend them to anyone who needs good service.

reviews.author: Saqunda Royal
reviews.text: I called and received a speedy response the tow truck was fast and was Also asked if I was in a safe location until he arrived. Offer to let me get out the heat until he was done. I was also able to purchase a new tire at there shop they are a all in one shop thank you guys at Bestco for being dependable.

reviews.author: Dustin Williams
reviews.text: Best tow company is Fayetteville and surrounding areas! Fair price, on time and friendly service! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Brittany Graham
reviews.text: A + services. Towed my dad’s van yesterday. Would definitely recommend. Update 28-Jan-21: My dad used this company again and the owner’s professionalism and punctuality were both stellar. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Gail Andrews
reviews.text: Terrell was ABSOLUTELY amazing!!! Great communication from beginning to end!! I am located in Charlotte and my mother is in Fayetteville and I was able to expedite having my mother's car towed and taken care of with EASE!!! 10 out of 10!!!!

reviews.author: Erica Anderson
reviews.text: Not too long ago I was in a very bad accident and a family member told me about getting bestco to tow away my car. When the driver came to the accident site he first checked on my safety and well being. I feel like that was such a nice thing to do. He also gave me some great details on what the next steps were. This was the first accident I had to handle on my own and he gave me so much comfort from the very start. Very great company!

reviews.author: Jeanine Covich
reviews.text: Great communication, professional, knowledgeable, took his time doing his job, all around a great service! Thank you

reviews.author: Denise Gibbs
reviews.text: When I say BESTCO is the BEST trust me it is!!! They were on time, affordable and the service was more than good!!!! You better get a tow from the BEST BESTCO they are #1 in my book!!! Don’t look no further this towing service is awesome!!!!!!

reviews.author: Denise Kling
reviews.text: Needed my car towed due to randomly shutting down... found out the issue was due to recall parts. Someone suggested I call Bestco for the tow. Very nice and friendly and patiently listened to me tell my car troubles over the phone. A driver, Tommy came and got my car towed to dealership before I got there. He was very polite and professional. I'm thankful they were referred to me... very happy with Bestco's towing service. I'll recommend them! Thanks Bestco and Tommy.

reviews.author: Ebonie Doughty
reviews.text: I reached out to BestCo Towing and received a speedy and professional response. I didn't have time to worry long because they got my vehicle transported quickly at an affordable rate. Thank you Terrell!

reviews.author: Charmone Manning
reviews.text: Fast and reliable service was @ my car in 10 minutes after giving them my information and was willing to take to another shop when I was told they don't except cars that's not running great job Bestco!!!!

reviews.author: Tinita Jackson
reviews.text: The driver was on time and very friendly, And even sent me a picture of where my vehicle was park, I would recommend this towing company to all my family and friend, I really appreciate the help.

reviews.author: Jeremy Jordan
reviews.text: I have used this company on several occasions to tow multiple vehicles. Communication has always been great and they have always arrived in a timely manner. I will continue to use them and refer them. Bobby is extremely professional when dealing with the customers.

reviews.author: hannah sargent
reviews.text: Excellent customer service, he was on time and very friendly. Took only a few minutes to get my vehicle hooked up and delivered to repair shop. Highly recommend this company for anyone that is needing a tow !

reviews.author: Maria Daggett
reviews.text: this company is amazing because their prices are very fair and their time management is out of this world. Their communication skills are 10 out of 10 and it was probably the easiest tow I’ve had to call to date.

reviews.author: EJ P
reviews.text: I was having to get my car serviced and the vehicle wouldn't start. I called the dealership and they suppled me with the company's information. They contacted me promptly, set up an amount of time it would take to come to my location. The driver arrived promptly and ws very professional. He contacted me once the car was delivered to the dealer.

reviews.author: Elise McKoy
reviews.text: Bestco Towing was very professional and expedient. The owner called me to explain the cost and process for having a vehicle towed. After the vehicle had been picked up and dropped off the driver called me to let me know where the vehicle had been dropped off and who he gave the keys to. I was unable to take the call so he texted me the information. I would recommend this company to anyone with towing needs. H. Elise McKoy-Cox

reviews.author: Angelia Wilkins
reviews.text: Great customer service, great rate, and arrived in a timely manner and gave me a courteous call to let me know my vehicle was delivered to its location. I will recommend this company to all my friends and family.

reviews.author: Sharon Strandberg
reviews.text: I have roadside assistance with my cell phone company, Verizon. I was in an accident last week with my Nissan Ultima and I set up an appointment yesterday through Verizon roadside assistance for a tow truck. The towing company called me and told me that my driver would be at my location in about 15 minutes. He was here in 10 minutes. He was finished in about 15 minutes. I didn’t have to lift a finger. I would definitely use this company again because of their awesome customer service and hard-working tow truck drivers.

reviews.author: Tri'Near Young
reviews.text: This is my go to for towing and I have been using them since 2021. They are Fast, friendly, and no hassle.

reviews.author: Lisa Dummitt
reviews.text: Awesome experience with these folks today! Pulled into the market, came out and my battery exploded! Yup, exploded, not cracked. These guys came right out, taught me something on my Jeep and towed me right to the dealership! Great rate, customer service and our driver was the best!!! Thanks so much Bestco!!!!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Boyd
reviews.text: A driver, Terell I think his name was, was extremely considerate! He called with an estimated pick up, called to let me know when the vehicle was dropped off and he let the dealership know that my back windshield was busted and that they needed to wrap it up to prevent interior damage. That was really unexpected and very much appreciated! Thank you!

reviews.text: Was prompt, car was parked in the right place, care was clearly taken and was called when job was complete. He asked me where I would like the car keys and upon arrival car was exactly where I asked for it to be parked and keys were where he said he left them. Highly recommend.

reviews.text: Bestco Towing were the BEST towing company I've ever used. They were prompt (30 minutes to pickup site), reasonably priced, polite and professional. Thank you so very much for helping me.

reviews.text: When dealing with any type of service from a company, it’s important to be professional and timely. This company has done just that for me. Not only was Mr. Terrell timely and efficient he was concerned about my car and my wellbeing as it was raining... I would definitely refer this tow company and I give 2 thumbs up!!

reviews.author: Unk Unk
reviews.text: Forced me to switch towing companies on the fly because he didn't want to dispatch a tow truck to get my vehicle to a mechanic that evening (7pm). The dispatcher refused to let me explain what I needed and hung up on me immediately after I said we might as well cancel the tow with them and I would find someone else. This was contracted through State Farm, but I went with another tow company and they were respectful and actually tried to meet my needs. I would personally look elsewhere if I were in a tight spot, as I don't believe this service is trustworthy or reliable.

reviews.text: Bestco Towing has provided me great service each time I have used them. They are always professional but also personable. They have always been prompt when responding to my roadside emergency. Thank you for all that you do.

reviews.author: La Muffina
reviews.text: I called Bestco today to see if they would provide me an in-city service 4 miles to where my alternator dead car would need to go. Mr. Tyrell gave me such affordable price, much less expensive than some other tow companys near by. No exaggerations needed. He was at my place within 15 minutes. He manuvered my lifeless 2008 car out of the parking lot with professionalism, finesse and expert precision despite no power steering and limited space. He was courteous to ensure I made it back to my building since he picked up my car and would be dropping it off without me. He asked who to give my keys to at the shop and informed me it would take another 15-20 min to arrive. He explained the payment authorization process. The auto repair shop informed me of when they recieved my car but not before Mr. Tyrell notified me that it had been safely delivered. Sir, I truly thank you for you kindness and reponsiveness. I didnt have to wait on you despite your busy day and you were willing to help me again later today, when I called. Your service is distinguished and exceeded my expectations. I hope not to require your services too often but should I need them again...your company will be a trusted brand for me and my household.

reviews.author: Chris Brown
reviews.text: The company arrived under estimated time, and also delivered my vehicle scratch free. Driver sent me a photo of vehicle at drop off location. Towing was affordable, I would strongly recommend this company to others. Thanks a lot !

reviews.author: Wendy McInteer
reviews.text: First, I have no problem owning up to my own parking mistake. I do not drive in that particular part of town, ever, and apparently it is a mistake lots of people make. That being said, this company is rude and the "boss" has delusions of grandeur. After getting my car towed due to parking in a lot that I apparently wasn't supposed to, the nightmare began. They verbally tell you a price to "drop" your vehicle and then change their minds due to the "boss" being inconvenienced. Then when I got to the place of business where they towed my vehicle, all I wanted to do was pay and get my vehicle. "The boss", instead of just taking payment through the service window, invites me to his office, which I assumed was to discuss the situation, then talks down to me, accuses me of wasting his time, and gets into a pissing contest with my 20 year old daughter because she is trying to explain things to him but he's got that, "I'm the man in charge" power attitude going. Several times I repeated I just wanted to pay and get my vehicle but he continued to rant and yell, instead of just filling out the paperwork, taking payment and letting both of us go about our day. This individual likes to intimidate and is on a power trip. Even saw him be rude and condescending to an employee while we were there. Eventually had to have my husband drive the 25 minutes from work to get the vehicle just because this man wanted to escalate a situation that didn't require it. He accuses people of wasting his time when I continually stated I just wanted to pay and get my vehicle and he just wanted to continue yelling, complaining about wasting his time and wanting to require me to have the police bring me back to get my vehicle. When he asked me into his office I should have just requested to pay through the service window and perhaps could have avoided his need to show dominance. Am overall cruddy experience that, thankfully, I will never again have to endure. At least I know who not to call if I ever need towing services. UPDATE: it's your story, you tell it any way you want , sir. Oh and if I could, I'd post a copy of the receipt because you most definitely didn't give my husband the discount, we paid the $170.00. So, you can see by the CAPS you keep using, who likes to scream and it isn't me, but you have a nice day.

My car wasn’t on chains nor did he start the tow process ansked politely once he pointed out staff sign is where to park for customers if I can just move my car there and he continued to bark I pay 130 or 260. Even the employees at the SSA office didn’t know people couldn’t park there. Terrible business practice by bestco I know the economy is hurting but to have a real winner of society try to bully me and force to pay. Reporting the city of Fayetteville, SSA and bbb

reviews.author: Shannon Illikainen
reviews.text: Being a female stuck on the side of the road with my 8yr old daughter in the middle of nowhere with the blazing hot sun beating down on us was a horrible experience. The tow truck driver was understanding and helpful from the time he called to confirm he was on his way until we reached our destination with my vehicle after hours(AMCCO TRANSMISSION on Bragg Blvd). He was kind and professional the entire time. On our journey back to Fayetteville I learned he had just suffered a terrible loss in his family (only a day or two ago). This gentleman chose to stay and wait with my daughter and I until the Lyft driver was less than a minute away when he should have been with his own family consoling them. Words alone can not say enough about my experience with this company. I would recommend them to anyone. Thank you so very much for making sure my little girl and I were safe. It means more than you’ll ever know!

reviews.text: Bestco Towing came and towed my Ford Fusion. The guy Brian was very nice. Their prices so far are the best I've seen around this area. They were on time and communtive.

reviews.author: Tiffany Bell
reviews.text: This towing company called because I used them through my roadside assistance. They asked me a lot of questions about my car. I answered them and the man was hesitant but said yes we will come to get it. I leave work taking an early lunch wait on the tow truck just to find out they can't tow it. Then I contact my roadside assistance and was told bestco sent a note in that my car was in the fence with two flat tires and it was like a salvage or something. Then once I got the car out of the fence, put air in the tires, and i sent this message to the towing company: Me: Hey this is the lady with the red car that was in the fence. I have the car out of the fence and the tires inflated. Can you all tow it now? The car goes in neutral too. Them: You would have to go thru your motor club again first because they have to issue out at P0# in order for payment Me: Yes I'm on hold with them now. Roadside assistance states the vendor told them they didn't want to pick up the vehicle and tell her they are unavailable. Me: Ok they said you were not willing to do it. You were not available. Thanks though. Them: Yeah I'm in South Carolina and the guy I have on call is leaving Fayetteville to take a car to Rocky Mount If this was true why tell me to get another PO. Seems like a lot of BS to me. They have lost my respect and I highly doubt roadside assistance was lying since all the calls are recorded. Terrible customer service.
